caption:
do sleep lines count as wrinkles?

Yes. Doctors describe them as their own kind of wrinkle, and in one study almost half of 201 adults over 60 had them.

Which side do you sleep on: left, right, back or stomach? One word below.

Expression lines follow your muscles. Sleep lines usually run across them, from your face being pressed into the pillow (Anson et al., Aesthetic Surgery Journal, 2016 review).

That number is for the forehead, from a 2026 study (Campos et al., An Bras Dermatol).

What we don't know yet: whether changing how you sleep prevents them. That hasn't been tested.

Skin Test #15/30 from a doctor in Seoul. Follow for #16: is it melasma or a sun spot?
